query:
UPDATE jobs
        SET status = 'queued'::job_status,
            attempts = 0,
            scheduled_at = NOW(),
            finished_at = NULL,
            started_at = NULL,
            last_error = NULL,
            owner = NULL
        WHERE id = $1 AND status IN ('failed'::job_status, 'done'::job_status, 'cancelled'::job_status)
